routes.name: Electric Crack
routes.desc: Leftmost line. No protection, use trad gear.
routes.setter: Jean Luc Jubert, Ernesto d'Angelo & Marco Ghibaudo, 2002

routes.name: Electric Crack (Variation)
routes.desc: Veers right about halfway of 'Electric Crack'. 3 old slings in the upper section. Bring trad gear!
routes.setter: Jean Luc Jubert, Ernesto d'Angelo & Marco Ghibaudo, 2002
warnings: Fixed Gear: 3 old slings in the upper section.

routes.name: The Prow
routes.desc: Shares anchors with 'Cazzi Vostri'. Old slings. Be prepared to replace.
routes.setter: Jean Luc Jubert, Ernesto d'Angelo & Marco Ghibaudo, 2002
warnings: Fixed Gear: Old slings. Be prepared to replace.

warnings: Fixed Gear: Old slings. Be prepared to replace.

routes.name: Paradise
routes.desc: Share start with Estata una Fortuna and Amphitheater. Take the left line to the lower anchor. Old slings. Be prepared to replace.
routes.setter: Jean Luc Jubert, Ernesto d'Angelo & Marco Ghibaudo, 2002
warnings: Fixed Gear: Old slings. Be prepared to replace.

routes.name: Estata una Fortuna
routes.desc: Variation of 'Paradise' and 'Amphitheater'. Veers right towards the end to a higher anchor. Old slings. Be prepared to replace.
routes.setter: Jean Luc Jubert, Ernesto d'Angelo & Marco Ghibaudo, 2002
warnings: Fixed Gear: Old slings. Be prepared to replace.

routes.name: Amphitheater
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Paradise' and 'Estata una Fortuna', then right just after the start. Old slings. Be prepared to replace.

warnings: Fixed Gear: Old slings. Be prepared to replace.
